Jubilee Hills SHO Suspended Over Misconduct Allegations

The Station House Officer (SHO) of Jubilee Hills police station has been suspended following allegations of extortion and blackmail by a woman complainant. The suspension order was issued after the woman accused the SHO of misconduct. The specific details of the alleged misconduct and the woman's complaint were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
